item.title: Australia: Remote Sensing and AI Advance Koala Habitat Mapping
item.description: University-led research combines hyperspectral airborne imagery and machine learning to map eucalyptus nutritional quality and distribution, enabling large-scale, data-driven conservation of koala habitats.

item.title: Thailand, China Strengthen Smart Agriculture Collaboration
item.description: Thailand and China are strengthening smart agriculture through research collaboration, technology exchange and human resource development to advance innovation, productivity and sustainable farming in the region.

item.title: Hong Kong: Digital Tech Transforms Elderly Stroke Recovery
item.description: A smart geriatric rehabilitation programme in Hong Kong effectively uses tele-rehabilitation and immersive digital technologies to significantly improve elderly stroke recovery while reducing frequent hospital visits.

item.title: Vietnam: Advancing Digital and Semiconductor Leadership
item.description: Vietnam is strongly pushing to advance its digital economy, semiconductor industry and technological capabilities under the “Make in Vietnam” spirit, focusing on innovation, skills and sustainable growth.

item.title: Malaysia Advances Smart Cities with AI and Robotics Integration
item.description: Malaysia is investing heavily in AI and robotics to develop smart cities, using robotics-as-a-service and advanced data-driven platforms to enhance urban living, operations, efficiency, and innovation.

item.title: India: Emerging Technologies Driving Employment, Skill Development
item.description: Emerging technologies such as drones, IoT and cybersecurity are rapidly creating new jobs and empowering youth through advanced skill development and innovation across rural and semi-urban India.

item.title: Australia: Future-Proofing Victoria’s Tech-Driven Energy Grid
item.description: Australia’s Victoria has launched a forward-looking Energy Safety Roadmap to modernise standards, strengthen regulations and ensure safe adoption of emerging renewable and electrified technologies.

item.title: Indonesia: Strengthening Child Protection in the Digital Era
item.description: Indonesia is intensifying efforts to protect children online through strict regulations, family-focused measures and coordinated actions against digital threats nationwide, ensuring safer digital environments.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST Develops Ultra-Low-Loss On-Chip Photodetector
item.description: HKUST researchers have developed a germanium-implanted silicon photodiode enabling precise, low-loss on-chip monitoring for scalable and energy-efficient programmable photonic systems.

item.title: Vietnam: Fostering Innovation-Led Sustainable Development
item.description: Resolution 57 is a key enabler for removing institutional bottlenecks and positioning science, technology and innovation at the centre of Vietnam’s sustainable and inclusive long-term national development strategy.
